description:
Save an agent for calls, texts, and email replies.

        The saved instructions and enabled channels apply when a number or email address
        routes to this agent. Saving the agent does not change existing routing.
        The call agent can hand over to listed contacts without seeing their phone numbers.

        Without a voice override, the built-in providers use the deployment's
        configured voice. A workspace provider uses its configured voice or its
        own default. An omitted language uses the speech providers' defaults (English).
        Without a tool list, the workspace's channels determine the available tools.
        The workspace call limit applies unless overridden, and the handover limit
        defaults to 30 minutes from the contact answering.

ai_disclosure.description: Speak the AI disclosure line first on every call.
ai_disclosure.title: Ai Disclosure

ai_disclosure_line.description: Custom AI disclosure line replacing the workspace line. ``{org}`` expands to the organization name.
ai_disclosure_line.title: Ai Disclosure Line

email_enabled.description: Whether this agent replies to mail on addresses routed to it.
email_enabled.title: Email Enabled

first_message.description: Greeting spoken after the AI disclosure. Without one, an inbound agent waits for the caller.
first_message.title: First Message

handover_contacts.description: Up to ten ``{contact_id, note}`` entries for people a call can be handed over to. ``contact_id`` is an ID from ``list_contacts``, ``lookup_contact`` or ``create_contact`` (a UUID or ``member:<user_id>``); the contact needs a phone number. ``note`` (1 to 200 characters) says when the agent hands over to that person, such as ``billing questions``.
handover_contacts.title: Handover Contacts

handover_max_duration_seconds.description: Longest a call may last after a handover contact answers, in seconds, counted from that answer.
handover_max_duration_seconds.title: Handover Max Duration Seconds

http_tools.description: Up to ten customer APIs the agent may call during calls, texts and email. Each entry: ``name`` (letters, digits, _), ``description`` (read by the model), ``url`` (public https), optional ``parameters`` (JSON Schema, type object), ``headers`` (static, stored encrypted, returned as names only), ``timeout_seconds`` (1 to 10, default 5) and ``wait_message`` (said on a call while waiting). The list replaces the saved one; an empty list removes it. On update, an entry without ``headers`` keeps the saved headers of the same name while the url keeps its host; a url on a new host needs ``headers`` again. The first save returns ``http_tool_secret`` once; requests carry ``X-Hail-Signature`` signed with it.
http_tools.title: Http Tools

knowledge.description: Whether this agent answers calls, texts and email from the workspace's knowledge base (``add_knowledge_document``). Needs the knowledge base turned on for the workspace by Hail support.
knowledge.title: Knowledge

language.description: Spoken language on calls, such as ``es`` for Spanish.
language.title: Language

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

max_duration_seconds.description: Longest a call with this agent may last, in seconds, counted from pickup. At the limit the agent says goodbye and hangs up.
max_duration_seconds.title: Max Duration Seconds

recording_enabled.description: Recording preference for this agent's calls, overriding the workspace setting.
recording_enabled.title: Recording Enabled

sms_enabled.description: Whether this agent answers texts on numbers whose texts route to it.
sms_enabled.title: Sms Enabled

system_prompt.description: Instructions that define the agent's behavior on calls, texts and email replies.
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

tools.description: Names of the tools the agent may use during a call or reply. Omitted: every tool the workspace's channels support. An empty list: none, except that a call keeps the tools every call needs (end_call, send_dtmf and Hail's settings guide). HTTP tools stay on. Hail adds call transfer when handover contacts are configured.
tools.title: Tools

voice_enabled.description: Whether this agent answers calls on numbers whose calls route to it.
voice_enabled.title: Voice Enabled

voice_id.description: Text-to-speech voice ID from the voice provider that serves the call, such as an ElevenLabs voice ID.
voice_id.title: Voice Id

name: create_agent

contact_id.description: The person: a contact's id, or `member:<user id>` for a team member.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

name.description: Name, as the agent says it.
name.title: Name

note.description: When the agent hands over to this person.
note.title: Note

phone_e164.description: Number Hail dials. Null when the contact lost its number; it is then skipped.
phone_e164.title: Phone E164

description.description: What the tool does. Read by the model.
description.title: Description

header_names.description: Names of the saved static headers. Values are never returned.
header_names.title: Header Names

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds Hail waits for the answer.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

wait_message.description: Sentence said on a call while waiting, or null.
wait_message.title: Wait Message

ai_disclosure.description: Whether the AI line is spoken first.
ai_disclosure.title: Ai Disclosure

ai_disclosure_line.description: This agent's AI line template, or null for the workspace line.
ai_disclosure_line.title: Ai Disclosure Line

first_message.description: Opening line, or null to wait.
first_message.title: First Message

handover_contacts.description: People the agent may hand a live call to.
handover_contacts.title: Handover Contacts

handover_max_duration_seconds.description: Call limit after a handover contact answers; null means 1800 (30 minutes).
handover_max_duration_seconds.title: Handover Max Duration Seconds

http_tool_secret.description: Secret that signs this agent's HTTP tool requests (X-Hail-Signature). Returned only when Hail creates it (the first save with HTTP tools) or rotates it (POST /agents/{id}/rotate-tool-secret). Store it then.
http_tool_secret.title: Http Tool Secret

http_tools.description: Your APIs the agent may call.
http_tools.title: Http Tools

knowledge.description: Whether the agent answers from the workspace's knowledge base.
knowledge.title: Knowledge

max_duration_seconds.description: Soft cap per call; null means the workspace limit.
max_duration_seconds.title: Max Duration Seconds

recording_enabled.description: Null inherits the workspace recording choice; true or false sets recording for this agent's calls, whatever the workspace setting.
recording_enabled.title: Recording Enabled
